# ai-models

Whisper small.en files for local transcription.

## whisper.cpp

ZIP: https://github.com/jwedwards-usa/ai-models/releases/latest/download/ggml-small.en.zip
ZIP SHA-256: https://github.com/jwedwards-usa/ai-models/releases/latest/download/ggml-small.en.zip.sha256
Raw model: https://github.com/jwedwards-usa/ai-models/releases/latest/download/ggml-small.en.bin
Model SHA-256: https://github.com/jwedwards-usa/ai-models/releases/latest/download/ggml-small.en.bin.sha256
Manifest: https://github.com/jwedwards-usa/ai-models/releases/latest/download/ggml-small.en.manifest.json

Use:
`unzip ggml-small.en.zip && whisper-cli -m ggml-small.en.bin -f audio.wav`

If the release ZIP cannot be downloaded, use the latest successful `Update Whisper small.en` Actions artifact matching `openai-whisper-small-en-ggml-*`.

## OpenAI Whisper / PyTorch

ZIP: https://github.com/jwedwards-usa/ai-models/releases/latest/download/openai-whisper-small-en-offline-model.zip
SHA-256: https://github.com/jwedwards-usa/ai-models/releases/latest/download/openai-whisper-small-en-offline-model.zip.sha256
